explanation: Compared against arXiv:2609.37744 (Huang–Ma–Yang), whose abstract proves Füredi's conjecture: for fixed r ≥ 4 and large n, the maximum number of edges in an r-uniform hypergraph with all disjoint pairs having distinct unions is C(n−1,r−1) + ⌊(n−1)/r⌋. The statement equates extremalNumber n t (¬HasRepeatedDisjointUnion) with that formula eventually in n, for each t ≥ 4. Faithful (the page's Füredi lower bound is the same expression).
